title: thelypteris latifolia
intro: Thelypteris latifolia, commonly known as the American maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to the southeastern United States, and its fronds are known for their distinctive lacy appearance. The health benefits of Thelypteris latifolia include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
